claims.claim: The proposal requests 3,810,423 ada, consisting of 3,699,440 ada for Mithril Protocol Continuous Development and 110,983 ada for the Intersect Budget Administration fee.
Mithril is presented as solving the cost and complexity of securely accessing and verifying Cardano blockchain state through stake-based threshold multi-signatures.
The proposal claims Mithril enables rapid trustless state verification without relying on the entire chain, centralized indexers, or hosted APIs.
The proposal claims faster sync times lower onboarding friction and unlock tooling for exchanges, wallets, monitoring, bridges, full wallets, light wallets, and light clients.

The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and provides references to voting records, documentation, final audited results, and an audit report.
The proposal states the requested amount did not breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit at submission, either alone or in aggregate, and links to the relevant governance action.

The proposal states audit and oversight costs are included in overhead, with independent oversight through Intersect and technically capable third parties, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls.
The proposal states Teragone has not previously received direct funding from Cardano treasury or community governance programs, while IOG has funded its Mithril work to date.

The proposal identifies a treasury smart-contract administration framework using TRSC and PSSC addresses, role thresholds, an Oversight Committee, documentation, dashboard, repository, and audit-report references.

The proposal states funds will first be directed to the TRSC stake address after enactment, then transferred to the PSSC when the legal contract is prepared and the vendor is ready, with milestones outlined in metadata.

summary: The document requests 3,810,423 ada for continued Mithril development via Intersect-administered treasury contracts, asserting infrastructure, decentralization, and adoption benefits while providing checkable references for budget-process approval, NCL compliance, treasury-contract operations, dashboard tracking, and audits.
